source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Removing createAdapter does not remove ListenerSet’s interface contract: add, has and delete call QueryInterface on the listener. The rewritten data-bag fixtures supply generated QueryInterface and keep only callbacks they exercise. Notification uses an observer snapshot, and the existing self-readd assertion expects one callback. notify catches and reports callback errors rather than silently treating every missing method as valid. The later accepted CalDAV and manager fixtures also add explicit interface support, a distinct phase from the original removal. No test was run in this study.
title: Calendar listener-set fixtures preserve QueryInterface after adapter removal
